name: 404-directory
description: Public read-only MCP infrastructure for searching current official AI and cloud documentation, verifying live web deployments, and discovering tools with transparent trust metadata.

npm.description: Identity-preserving stdio bridge to the public 404.directory Streamable HTTP service. No account or API key is required.

examples.title: Research current official documentation
examples.description: Answer a real implementation question using first-party sources.
examples.prompt: Use search_official_docs to find the current official guidance for MCP Streamable HTTP. Cite the first-party sources and distinguish facts from inference.

examples.title: Verify a public deployment
examples.description: Check a concrete release claim using structured public evidence.
examples.prompt: Use verify_web to confirm that https://404.directory is reachable over HTTPS and currently exposes release 0.9.2.

examples.title: Choose a trusted read-only tool
examples.description: Search and inspect tools before recommending one.
examples.prompt: Use search_tools, get_tool, and get_trust_score to recommend a read-only tool for verifying a public web deployment.
